voice_mode: prototype_tts_only; final recorded VO is production work

start.text: 404 is more than a label. We are finally close enough to prove it.

evidence-chain.text: Put every piece on the table. Nothing gets assumed.

cross-check.text: The threads agree. That is the strongest evidence we have.

confirm.text: Now we know what 404 actually means.

complete.text: The operation has a shape. The next choice is ours.

start.text: Truth is only useful if you know who can survive hearing it.

commit-choice.text: Choose carefully. A decision like this does not stay private.

secure-choice.text: Choice locked. We move forward with it.

complete.text: Now we live with the choice.

start.text: All right. No speeches. We do the job and get out.

stage-operation.text: Everything is where it needs to be. That is almost suspicious.

survive.text: Still standing. I will take that as a win.

complete.text: The operation is done. The consequences are already moving.

start.text: After 404, the city does not simply forget.

assess.text: Look at what changed. That is the real ending.

epilogue.text: We finished what we started. Now the world state matters.

leave-mark.text: No clean slate. Just a final state.

complete.text: That is what remains after the noise stops.

start.text: East Market is loud enough to hide a signal. That is why they chose it.

track-exchange.text: Buyer, seller, signal. Nobody loses the thread.

identify.text: We have all three. Preserve it.

complete.text: A small exchange can expose a large network.

start.text: Rain makes everybody look innocent. Perfect.

position.text: I have the angle. Nobody knows I am here.

record.text: Keep recording. We only get one clean meeting.

complete.text: The recording is worth more than a confrontation.

start.text: North Hills contacts do not give answers for free.

earn-cooperation.text: Good. We can work with that.

obtain-address.text: Address secured. Now we know where to look.

complete.text: People talk when they believe the alternative is worse.

start.text: A manifest is only useful when the cargo disagrees with it.

compare-shipment.text: Line by line. Find the lie.

find-mismatch.text: There it is. That number does not belong.

photograph.text: Captured. The page survives even if the paper does not.

complete.text: One mismatch is enough to open the right door.

start.text: Airport crowds. Finally, a place where following somebody looks normal.

track-network.text: Stay on the route. Do not force the destination.

destination.text: Got it. They are leaving Veyron.

start.text: Rumors become useful when they leave footprints.

investigate-rumor.text: There is something here. The rumor was not invented from nothing.

verify.text: Physical proof. That changes the weight of the story.

return-proof.text: Proof secured. Blackwater just became part of the map.

complete.text: We came for a rumor. We are leaving with a lead.
